title: Text to Speech declares the Voice Changer weights it never loads
description: chatter-box.requiredDeps lists chatterbox-vc-s3gen and chatterbox-vc-conds (1.0GB). The TTS graph runs FL_ChatterboxTTS + FL_ChatterboxMultilingualTTS; chatterbox_vc/ is resolved only by load_vc_model(), called solely from FL_ChatterboxVCNode. Every TTS user downloads 1.0GB they never use, the drawer overstates the flow at 6.9GB instead of 5.96GB, and the declaration makes Voice Changer permanently un-uninstallable because the flow dep guard walks declared flows.
